title: A producer fills a drum row from the Generate panel

steps.caption: Add a second pad to the starter drum machine
Open the BD clip: a kick row and an empty Pad 2 row
Click the Pad 2 row's name to select it
Press Offbeats: the row fills with offbeats
Write a 3-over-8 Euclidean rhythm over the offbeats
Undo and redo the generate as one step
The instrument view has Pad 2 selected too
Reload: both rows are still there
